summary.text: Mike Harris is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 52 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Mike Harris's general-election opponent is Brendan Leddy (D).
He was previously a sergeant and shift commander with the Waterford Township Police Department and chairs the House Insurance Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mike R. Harris lives in Waterford, Michigan, graduated from Akron-Fairgrove High School, and earned an associate degree in criminal justice from Mott Community College in 1993.
His career experience includes working as president of Paladin Training & Consulting, LLC and as a sergeant and shift commander with the Waterford Township Police Department.
He has been affiliated with the Sons of the American Legion, the Michigan Coalition of Responsible Gun Owners, and the Clarkston Rotary Club.
Harris assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023.
In 2025-2026 he chairs the Insurance Committee, is Majority Vice Chair of the House Government Operations Committee, and also serves on the Economic Competitiveness and Judiciary committees.
